description: Upgrade existing WhatIfSimulator.tsx with peak-to-off-peak shift slider and side-by-side comparison
steps: Modify src/components/WhatIfSimulator.tsx to add: slider (0-100%) for shifting peak usage to off-peak
Add side-by-side comparison: original vs simulated bills for all 3 plans
Show monthly/annual savings from the shift in INR using formatINR
Implement conservation logic: simPeak = peak * (1 - shift/100), simOffPeak = offPeak + peak * (shift/100)
Update tooltips and labels to use INR formatting
Ensure total kWh is conserved in calculations
acceptance_criteria: Slider adjusts from 0% to 100% peak shift
Simulated bills update in real-time as slider moves
Savings calculations show correct INR values
Before/after visualization is clear and informative
verification: Test slider interaction - verify bills update
Check that 0% shift shows original values
Verify 100% shift moves all peak to off-peak
Test conservation: original total kWh = simulated total kWh
Run existing tests to ensure no regressions
